basis: CODEX_HANDOFF P0 project assumptions; leakage areas reuse Lite shaft_floor_leak/elev_leak, not measured building leakage

source_input.basis: Coverage and aperture coefficients retain the existing project supply prescription, not measured fuel inventory or solved oxygen flow. Growth uses each class t_alpha in fire_load_table.json (1000/t_alpha^2). Unknown classes retain explicitly labelled provisional table values. Zero effective apertures do not prescribe zero pyrolysis; native oxygen limitation handles actual burning.

leakage.basis: 일반 지하 6회/h는 설계 환기 횟수 가정. 주차장 27 m³/㎡·h는 건축물의 설비기준 등에 관한 규칙 별표 1의6 자동차 관련 시설 환기량 참조. 주 배기덕트 풍속 8 m/s는 사용자 지정 통상 범위 4.5~8 m/s 상한 가정. 실측 아님, 환기 경로 등가 가정; 실제 팬 운전·화재 시 환기 성능 보증 아님.

validation_basis: Pressure and mass balance are rejection limits. Fuel fraction 0.3 is a prescribed-pyrolysis input review trigger; source HRR energy ratio 0.5 is diagnostic only. CFAST 7.7.7 fire.f90 do_fire adds prescribed fuel to the upper layer independently of oxygen-limited burning; outputspreadsheet.f90 HRR excludes separate DJET combustion. Neither diagnostic is a universal physical validity bound.

quasi_steady.basis: Project simplification, not CFAST and not a measured rule. A run that cannot reach the horizon inside max_wall_s while its last window_s of output is steady (constant heat release, pinned oxygen and layer, slow pressure drift) is stopped and completed from its own last values; temperatures continue as dT ~ t^p with p fitted on the last two windows and capped (McCaffrey-Quintiere-Harkleroad wall heating gives 1/6). Extended results are reported as unverified.

native_execution.basis: A wall-time budget, not a physical constant. The 60-minute factory 7F sample exceeded 3600 wall seconds; allow 4200 while retaining the accepted-step stall guard. Accepted steps prove progress even when rounded simulation time is unchanged.

native_floor_flux.basis: Equal-area midpoint quadrature of upward-facing floor gauges, 0.02 m above floor. User-selected 8x8 (64) gauges in initially burning physical rooms; 5F R16 8x8 to 16x16 changed peak by 1.7%. Other rooms use 2x2 and may require refinement if they ignite. CFAST 7.7.7 target.f90 TRGFLXI is incident radiation multiplied by target emissivity; a black gauge measures incident radiation without convection or reradiative subtraction. Sampled area mean, not a local maximum. Stock cparams mxitems=25*101; outputspreadsheet ssprintresults has 16384 cells and validation output uses 36 columns per plate.

display_output.basis: Round only newly saved playback for display. Keep raw native CSV, input, analytical result and MC summary precision. Do not round a below-boundary degree up across the 70/100 display decision boundary.

cad_equivalent_geometry.basis: Geometry placement guard above the existing 0.6 m rule-cell minimum; optional 0.2 m total jamb margin yields to exact area/volume and aperture-width preservation. Not a physical room enlargement.

native_compartments.basis: CFAST physical room zones. Artificial full-height inter-cell vents produced mass drift in controlled native runs; keep prescribed sources and target locations.
